gce_cluster_config.description: Configuration for the cluster's virtual machine instances.

internal_ip_only.description: If true, all instances in the cluster will only have internal IP addresses.
internal_ip_only.security_impact: Critical. If false, cluster nodes are assigned public IP addresses, exposing them directly to the internet and increasing the risk of unauthorized access.
internal_ip_only.rationale: To enforce a private, secure-by-default network posture, this must be set to 'true'.

service_account.description: The service account for the GCE instances. If not specified, the default service account is used.
service_account.security_impact: High. The default Compute Engine service account has broad, project-wide permissions. Using it grants the cluster excessive privileges, violating the principle of least privilege.
service_account.rationale: A dedicated, least-privilege service account must be specified to limit the cluster's permissions to only what is necessary.
service_account.non-compliant: # The 'service_account' argument is omitted, causing it to use the default.

kms_key_name.description: The Cloud KMS key used for encryption of data at rest.
kms_key_name.security_impact: High. Without a specified CMEK, data is encrypted with a Google-managed key. Using a CMEK provides greater control and auditability over data protection.
kms_key_name.rationale: To comply with data protection and governance policies, clusters must use a customer-managed key.

image_version.description: The version of software installed on the cluster.
image_version.security_impact: Medium. Older image versions can contain known vulnerabilities that could be exploited.
image_version.rationale: To ensure clusters are protected against known exploits, a recent, supported image version must be used.
